sesotho_text: Ke rata ho tseba sekhahla sa ho hloleha ha mekhoa e fapaneng ea thibelo ea ho mitsa.

english_text: I was told no contraceptive method is one hundred percent effective.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore ha ho mokhoa oa thibelo ea ho mitsa o sebetsang lekholong la lekholong.

english_text: I was told to use two methods of contraception for better protection.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe ho sebelisa mekhoa e mebeli ea thibelo ea ho mitsa bakeng sa tšireletso e ntle.

english_text: I was told to use condoms even if I am on another contraceptive.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe ho sebelisa li-condom le ha ke ntse ke sebelisa mokhoa o mong oa thibelo ea ho mitsa.

english_text: I was told that some medications can reduce the effectiveness of the pill.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore meriana e meng e ka fokotsa bokgoni ba pilisi.

english_text: I was told that antibiotics can affect my contraceptive pill.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore li-antibiotic li ka angoa pilisi ea thibelo ea ho mitsa ea ka.

english_text: I was told to use a backup method when I am on antibiotics.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe ho sebelisa mokhoa oa tšireletso ha ke ntse ke nka li-antibiotic.

english_text: I was told that vomiting can reduce the effectiveness of the pill.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore ho hlatsa ho ka fokotsa bokgoni ba pilisi.

english_text: I was told to take a missed pill as soon as I remember.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe ho nka pilisi e lahlehileng hang hang ha ke hopola.

english_text: I was told that the pill does not protect against sexually transmitted infections.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore pilisi ha e sireletse ho tšoaetso tse fetisanang ka thobalano.

english_text: I was told that condoms are the only method that prevents STIs.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore li-condom ke mokhoa o le mong feela o thibelang li-STI.

english_text: I was advised to get tested for STIs before starting a new contraceptive.
sesotho_text: Ke keletsoeng ho hlahlojoa bakeng sa li-STI pele ho qala mokhoa o mocha oa thibelo ea ho mitsa.

english_text: I was told that family planning is available free of charge at the clinic.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore ho rererela lelapa ho fumaneha mahala klinikeng.

english_text: I was told that I have the right to choose my own contraceptive method.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore ke na le tokelo ea ho khetha mokhoa oa ka oa thibelo ea ho mitsa.

english_text: I was told that my partner's consent is not required for family planning.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore tumelo ea molekane oa ka ha e hlokahaleng bakeng sa ho rererela lelapa.

english_text: I was told that family planning information is confidential.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore tlhahisoleseling ea ho rererela lelapa ke sephiri.

english_text: I was told that teenagers can also access family planning services.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore bacha le bona ba ka fihlela litšebeletso tsa ho rererela lelapa.

english_text: I was told that family planning helps space pregnancies for better health.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore ho rererela lelapa ho thusa ho arohanya likhutsana bakeng sa bophelo bo botle.

english_text: I was told that spacing pregnancies improves maternal and child health.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore ho arohanya likhutsana ho ntlafatsa bophelo ba mme le ngoana.

english_text: I was told that having too many pregnancies too close together is risky.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore ho ba le likhutsana tse ngata haholo tse haufi haholo li le kotsi.

english_text: I was told that family planning reduces maternal and infant mortality.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore ho rererela lelapa ho fokotsa lefu la bomme le la bana ba banyenyane.

english_text: I was told about the benefits of waiting at least two years between pregnancies.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe ka melemo ea ho ema bonyane lilomo tse peli lipakeng tsa likhutsana.

english_text: I was told that family planning supports women's empowerment.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore ho rererela lelapa ho tshehetsa matla a basali.

english_text: I was told that men should also be involved in family planning decisions.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore le banna ba lokela ho kenyeletsoa liqetong tsa ho rererela lelapa.

english_text: I was advised to discuss family planning with my partner.
sesotho_text: Ke keletsoeng ho buisana le molekane oa ka ka ho rererela lelapa.

english_text: I was told that family planning is not only for women.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore ho rererela lelapa ha se bakeng sa basali feela.

english_text: I was told that family planning services are available at all public clinics.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore litšebeletso tsa ho rererela lelapa li fumaneha likiliniking tsohle tsa sechaba.

english_text: I was told to come back to the clinic if I experience any problems.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe ho khutla klinikeng haeba ke ikutloa mathata afe kafe.

english_text: I was told to report any unusual bleeding or pain after starting contraception.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe ho bua ka ho tsoa mali kapa mahloko afe kafe a sa tloaelehang ka mor'a ho qala thibelo ea ho mitsa.

english_text: I was told to do a pregnancy test if I miss my period while on contraception.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe ho etsa tlhahlobo ea ho mitsa haeba ke lahlehetsoe ke nako ea khoeli ha ke ntse ke sebelisa thibelo ea ho mitsa.

english_text: I was told to come to the clinic immediately if I think I am pregnant while on an IUD.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe ho tla klinikeng hang hang haeba ke nahana hore ke mitsa ha ke ntse ke na le IUD.

english_text: I was told that some contraceptives can cause irregular periods.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore lithibelo tse ling tsa ho mitsa li ka baka linako tsa khoeli tse sa tloaelehang.

english_text: I was told that the injection can cause my periods to stop completely.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore ente e ka baka hore linako tsa khoeli ea ka li eme ka botlalo.

english_text: I was told that my periods will return after stopping the injection.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore linako tsa khoeli ea ka li tla khutla ka mor'a ho emisa ente.

english_text: I was told that it may take time to fall pregnant after stopping the injection.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore ho ka nka nako ho mitsa ka mor'a ho emisa ente.

english_text: I was told that fertility returns quickly after stopping the pill.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore bokgoni ba ho ba le bana bo khutla kapele ka mor'a ho emisa pilisi.

english_text: I was told that the implant can be removed at any time.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore implant e ka ntšoa nako efe kafe.

english_text: I was told that fertility returns immediately after implant removal.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore bokgoni ba ho ba le bana bo khutla hang hang ka mor'a ho ntšoa ha implant.

english_text: I was told that the IUD can remain in place for up to five years.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore IUD e ka lula sebakeng sa yona ho fihlela lilomo tse hlano.

english_text: I was told that the hormonal IUD can also help with painful periods.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore IUD ea li-hormone le yona e ka thusa ka linako tsa khoeli tse bohlokang.

english_text: I was told that the copper IUD does not contain hormones.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore IUD ea copper ha e na li-hormone.

english_text: I was told that the copper IUD can also be used as emergency contraception.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore IUD ea copper le yona e ka sebelisoa joalo ka thibelo ea ho mitsa ea tšohanyetso.

english_text: I was told that emergency contraception does not cause an abortion.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore thibelo ea ho mitsa ea tšohanyetso ha e baki ho lahla ngoana.

english_text: I was told that emergency contraception prevents fertilisation.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore thibelo ea ho mitsa ea tšohanyetso e thibela ho hlopha ha peo.

english_text: I was told to use regular contraception after taking emergency contraception.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe ho sebelisa thibelo ea ho mitsa ea kamehla ka mor'a ho nka thibelo ea ho mitsa ea tšohanyetso.

english_text: I was told that family planning helps me plan for my future.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore ho rererela lelapa ho nthusa ho rererela bokamoso ba ka.

english_text: I was told that family planning empowers me to decide the size of my family.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore ho rererela lelapa ho mpha matla a ho etsa qeto ka boholo ba lelapa la ka.
